title: Oscar and the Letter
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Isandro Voss, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
